topic: Gemini features that work inside Google's own apps
details: Animated/carousel-format reel covering Gemini AI integrations across Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Drive, Photos, etc. — features most users have never turned on.
subject: Gemini features that work inside Google's own apps
audience: Everyday Gmail/Docs/Sheets/Drive users who've heard of Gemini but never noticed it's already built into the apps they use daily
core_value: Exactly where real, currently-live Gemini features sit inside Gmail, Docs, Sheets and Drive, what each does differently, and whether the viewer already has access
desired_action: Save the reel, then open one of these apps and try the feature
tone: Plain, specific, no hype — numbers do the talking, same register as five-free-ai-tools and 5-chatgpt-features
footage_constraints: ANIMATED TREATMENT: facePlan bookends (presenter on hook + CTA only), stage scenes for each Google-app feature, music bed on. Official Google Workspace/Gemini Help Center screenshots and product-page stills as proof wherever they exist.
